1.  RECOMMENDATION TO RECEIVE SUPPORTING DOCUMENTATION INTO THE RECORD,
  CONCLUDE THE PUBLIC HEARING;
  ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 2022­004, RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PLNG2021­0026
  (GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT), AN AMENDMENT TO THE GENERAL PLAN LAND USE
  ELEMENT MAP, FROM GENERAL COMMERCIAL TO HIGH DENSITY RESIDENTIAL (HDR),
  FOR PROPERTY LOCATED AT 12345 CARSON STREET, ASSESSOR PARCEL NUMBER
  7066­017­012 CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS, CALIFORNIA; AND ADOPTION OF THE INITIAL
  STUDY/MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION AND MITIGATION MONITORING PROGRAM
  FOR THE PROJECT UNDER THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT;
  ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 2022­005 CONSIDERING CASE NO. PLNG2021­0025 (ZONE
  CHANGE), TO THE CITY COUNCIL OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS TO ADOPT AN ORDINANCE
  APPROVING THE REZONING A PROPERTY FROM C­4 (GENERAL COMMERCIAL) TO R­4
  (HIGH DENSITY RESIDENTIAL), FOR PROPERTY LOCATED AT 12345 CARSON STREET,
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS, CALIFORNIA; AND
  ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 2022­006 CONSIDERING CASE NO. PLNG2021­0025 (SITE PLAN
  REVIEW), A REQUEST TO APPROVE THE SITE PLAN AND ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN OF A
  NEW 13­UNIT APARTMENT COMPLEX ON PROPERTY LOCATED AT 12345 CARSON
  STREET CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS, CALIFORNIA
  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Maryann Marks, Interim Community Development Director, spoke and recommended to continue
  the item to the Planning Commission meeting of April 27, 2022.
  Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, spoke.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Hernandez, seconded by Commissioner Navarro, that the

  April 27, 2022.
